answer: Clay pits stretch behind the brickfield, and the moulds lie in rows by the drying shed. Proof of brick-maker via brick tally — a brick the brick-maker fires only after 31 bricks come hard without one cracking at the corner, each fired by the brick-maker himself. atlas throws the clay into the mould and strikes it level. pearl turns the bricks out and sets them to dry in the sun. ripple stacks the kiln and fires it slow through the night. Thirty-one bricks must come hard without one cracking at the corner, and the next still cracks where the clay ran short of sand.
